mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals monetary easing, compressing discount rates on equity cash flows, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year window or 20-day returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An upward movement in the unemployment rate above 3.6% triggers a negative S&P 500 return as elevated joblessness reduces consumer confidence and corporate investment.
failure_condition: S&P 500 returns remain positive despite UNRATE crossing above 3.6% in the next 20 days.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent growth in both GDP (GDPC1) and housing demand (HOUST) strengthens economic momentum, driving positive equity returns over 60 days.
candidate_trigger: both GDPC1 and HOUST rising in same month
failure_condition: 20-day returns fail to rise when both GDPC1 and HOUST show consecutive monthly growth.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, low inflation (CPIAUCSL < 2.0) and ultra-low rates (FEDFUNDS < 1.0%) create favorable conditions for equity valuations, boosting returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: Returns do not outperform baseline during late-cycle expansion periods defined by CPIAUCSL < 2.0 and FEDFUNDS < 1.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Rising quarterly GDP (GDPC1) indicates expanding economic activity, which typically correlates with positive equity returns within the next week.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not positive when GDPC1 shows growth.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5%, signaling aggressive tightening, market expectations for slower growth lead to negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: Returns turn positive despite FEDFUNDS exceeding 4.5% in the next 20 days.

mechanism_narrative: High jobless claims (PAYEMS > 1.5M) combined with falling unemployment (UNRATE < 3.0%) creates a recessionary signal, causing negative returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are positive when both high jobless claims and falling unemployment occur.

mechanism_narrative: Strong supply growth (INDPRO > 105.6) alongside low inflation (CPIAUCSL < 2.5) in an expansionary supply cycle drives positive equity returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: Returns underperform in expansionary supply cycles defined by INDPRO > 105.6 and CPIAUCSL < 2.5.
